answer: An open escrow account (otwarty mieszkaniowy rachunek powierniczy) allows the developer to use the funds deposited by the buyer to finance or refinance the development project [3]. A closed escrow account (zamknięty mieszkaniowy rachunek powierniczy) keeps the deposited funds locked until the rights from the purchase agreement are transferred to the buyer, at which point the funds are released in a single payment [4]. Additionally, with a closed account, the bank releases funds to the developer only after receiving a notarial deed confirming the transfer of rights to the buyer free from encumbrances [5].
